name: Auberdine Refugee Camp
summary: Auberdine Refugee Camp is a makeshift settlement established on the forested outskirts of Auberdine in Darkshore. As darkness and corruption creep along the coast, displaced kaldorei and travelers gather here under the watchful eyes of Sentinel scouts. It serves as a precarious sanctuary for those forced from their homes along the wild shore.

sections.title: Haven on the Coast
sections.body: Perched near the coastal paths of Darkshore, this refugee camp offers a fragile safe haven amidst mounting turmoil. Displaced night elves and wandering refugees shelter under canvas tents and ancient trees, relying on Kaldorei Sentinels and vigilant archers to keep hostile wildlife and coastal threats at bay.

faq.q: Why are there refugees in Darkshore?
faq.answer: With creeping corruption, aggressive wildlife, and coastal hazards unsettling northern Kalimdor, local travelers and night elves displaced from threatened homesteads seek safety near established defenses.
Kaldorei Sentinels and archers maintain a perimeter around the settlement, keeping aggressive beasts and encroaching perils from overrunning the makeshift camp.

faq.q: Is the camp safe for travelers?
faq.answer: The camp is firmly under night elf stewardship and aligned with the Alliance, offering friendly harbor to allies, while remaining deeply cautious of outsiders.

angles.text: Seeing your kin huddled under makeshift awnings is a sober reminder that even the ancient forests of northern Kalimdor are under siege by unseen corruptions.
A vital bastion of hospitality, this camp offers safety for Alliance adventurers traveling the windswept and dangerous shores of Darkshore.
